# ViraStack AI

> AI-native architecture kit for modern React. One command injects disciplined agent rules for Cursor, Claude Code, and other agents. npm: `@virastack/ai` (~1.3.1).

Install: `npx @virastack/ai init`. Detects Next.js vs TanStack Start from `package.json` and writes only the relevant rules.

For inline CLI + injected file list, prefer [llms-full.txt](https://virastack.com/ai/llms-full.txt).

## Docs & pages

- [AI overview](https://virastack.com/ai): Product landing (how it works, injected rules, CLI)
- [llms-full.txt](https://virastack.com/ai/llms-full.txt): Full machine-readable AI guide
- [npm `@virastack/ai`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@virastack/ai): Package registry
- [GitHub](https://github.com/virastack/ai): Source and rule templates

## What it writes

- `AGENTS.md` — universal agent operating guide
- `CLAUDE.md` — Claude Code entry (`@AGENTS.md`)
- `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` — scoped Cursor rules
- `docs/` — architecture guide and project memory templates

- [ViraStack llms.txt](https://virastack.com/llms.txt): Ecosystem map
- [Start](https://virastack.com/start/llms.txt): Scaffolds that pre-install AI
